title: Multimodality Helps Few-shot 3D Point Cloud Semantic Segmentation

layout.note: Two mirrored left-to-right lanes split by a dashed vertical line: support cloud and mask above, query at the left, one model box in the middle, prediction at the right. The right lane adds a Text chip and a 2D Images stack; a dashed legend box for the arrow colours sits at the top centre over the divider.

lesson: Draw the baseline and the proposed model in mirrored lanes on the same sample scene, so the extra inputs (a text chip, a stack of photos) are the only visible difference, and use a small arrow-colour key to say which inputs exist only in pretraining.
